_doc: Event-rule thresholds. Source of truth should be A's spec salespeople_prompts/2026-10-11-showroom-coach-design.md (sections 4.5/4.6); that file is NOT in the repo, so every value here is a documented fallback. FLAG: replace with A's exact values when the spec arrives; only this file changes.

_source.greet_dist_m / greet_facing_deg / greet_: teammate_c_synthetic_showroom.md section 4.3 ('greet <= 1.5 m, facing <= 60 deg, >= 2 s or 5 s'): 2 s for short_clip, 5 s for dealership
_source.engage_dist_m: fallback: same conversational radius as greet (1.5 m)
_source.engage_min_s: fallback: 10 s short clip; 60 s dealership (dealership_long scenario needs an engagement > 120 s)
_source.wait_alert_s: fallback: 30 s short clip (greet_slow greets at 40-70 s = 'missed while free'), 120 s dealership
_source.walkout_min_present_s: fallback: ignore pass-throughs shorter than 10 s
_source.party_dist_m / party_min_s / party_windo: fallback: two customers within 2.0 m for >= 3 s, starting within 10 s of arriving
